root_idea.summary: The root centers on weakness or loss of strength, whether bodily or in resolve, and also has a separate temporal branch denoting a period of the night.
root_idea.development: The principal semantic branch is weakness, extending from bodily infirmity to weakened energy or character and to causative forms meaning to make weak. A distinct homonymous branch denotes a night-time period and related temporal usage.

senses.definition: To be or become weak, infirm, or enervated.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of bodily condition or a bodily part; it includes languor, weakness of structure, enervation, or laxity in the joints.

senses.definition: To lose strength or heart; to become dispirited or cowardly.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of a person or group in resolve, morale, an undertaking, or pursuit, rather than only of bodily weakness.

senses.definition: The weakest; most fragile in strength.
senses.usage_conditions: An elative adjective used in a comparison of strength or structural weakness.

senses.definition: One who weakens; that which makes someone or something weak.
senses.usage_conditions: An active participle of the causative Form IV usage, taking the weakened person, thing, or undertaking as its object.

senses.definition: Weakness; weakness upon weakness as pregnancy advances.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction وَهْنًا عَلَى وَهْنٍ, it denotes increasing or successive physical weakness associated with pregnancy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A period of the night, especially around midnight, after an hour, or as the night departs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A temporal noun belonging to the root's separate time-related branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A disease affecting the sides of the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A medical usage distinct from the anatomical term for the rib.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who is sluggish, moves little, and is heavy or slow to rise and sit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The gender specification is part of the lexical definition of this derived noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter or travel during that night-time period.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A temporal homonym, distinct from the Quranic elative adjective and from the causative verb meaning to weaken.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state of being weak or languid, especially being unable to rise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived noun describing marked physical debility or languor.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Its bodily and dispositional weakness branches are covered by the two Form I senses.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the Form IV entry.
Causative weakening is represented by the Quranic active participle.
Temporal meaning of وَهْنٌ is represented.
Pointer-only cross-reference; its lexical gloss is supplied independently by Maqayis.
Derived term for marked weakness or languor is represented.

cautions: أَوْهَن in 29:41 is presented as an elative adjective meaning “the weakest,” whereas مُوهِن in 8:18 is an active participle meaning “one who weakens.”
The temporal sense of وَهْنٌ / مَوْهِنٌ is a distinct homonymous branch and should not be conflated with weakness.
